name: APK Install Error Decoder
description: Built after debugging the same failed APK installs again and again: paste an adb or Package Installer error and get the likely cause plus the safest fix first, so you don't wipe app data by mistake. Covers six common errors (UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE, VERSION_DOWNGRADE, NO_MATCHING_ABIS, OLDER_SDK, DEPRECATED_SDK_VERSION, INSUFFICIENT_STORAGE). Runs entirely in the browser; nothing is uploaded.
